GET /api/v1.description: Serves a JSON representation of all available endpoints of the API

GET /api/v1/films.description: Returns an array of all films

films.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

GET /api/v1/films/{imdbId}.description: Returns a single film by its IMDb ID

film.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish

POST /api/v1/reviews.description: Creates a new review for a film

GET /api/v1/reviews/film/{imdbId}.description: Returns all reviews associated with a specific film by its IMDb ID

DELETE /api/v1/reviews/{id}.description: Deletes a review by its ID. Requires the film's IMDb ID to properly remove the review reference from the film's review list.

errorResponses.400: Bad Request - Invalid review ID format or missing imdbId
errorResponses.404: Not Found - Review does not exist
